newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA AVERAGE ONE-WEEK RATE RISES TO 52.57 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA AVERAGE ONE-WEEK RATE RISES TO 52.57 PCT.

text.p: Romania's central bank said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week refinancing funds rose to 52.57 percent from last week's 51.54 percent.

The central bank's offer of 1.25 trillion lei, down from the previous week's 1.35 trillion, was slightly oversubscribed with four banks entering 1.28 trillion worth of bids at prices ranging between 52 to 53 percent.
On Thursday, the central bank raised the minimum permitted rate by one percentage point to 52 percent in a move to tighten its monetary policies to prop up the leu.
The leu's retail rates dipped to some 4,350 to the dollar from about 3,500 in mid-October. Its interbank rates on Friday were far firmer, at 3,530/50.
